ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (black) ventral surface punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized clusters and linear features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity pixels dominate the central and basal regions; high-intensity white circular rosettes are concentrated at the distal tips; a series of high-contrast white linear parallel markings is localized to the mid-distal region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Prominent, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks across both lobes; a significant, high-amplitude traumatic notch is visible on the inner-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve displaying convexity from the median notch through the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular white pixel rings (barnacle scars) located primarily on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct set of roughly six parallel, vertical-to-diagonal high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) situated on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible 3D cluster of acorn/stalked barnacles attached to the extreme left distal tip; significant irregular indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe lobe proximal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of heavy barnacle encrustation on the left tip and the high-contrast parallel rake marks on the left lobe provides a unique geometric signature.
